description: The artist's pictures or videos in Audora's Library, newest first, searchable by name and filterable by category (Brand kit, Logo, Cover art, Promo, a platform, Generated, Uploaded, Stock footage). Each has a media_asset_id (what update_post takes) and a preview link valid for an hour.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

categories.description: Only items in every one of these.

search.description: Words in the item's name, or the artist, track or album it belongs to.
